_about: Documented, publicly reported landslide/washout events on or near the corridor, compiled from web search results during Phase 1. Everything here is confidence=unverified: a person must open each source and confirm before anything is marked verified. No coordinates are given because the sources give none; events attach to a graph Place only when a source names it. Casualty details are intentionally omitted.

events.description: Landslide at Dzudza on NH-29 between Kohima and Dimapur. An official order closed a short stretch for landslide removal, and the Kohima Deputy Commissioner later reported complete blockage and advised light vehicles to use alternate routes. A fresh mudslide after heavy rain on 22 August hindered restoration.
events.date_note: Sources differ: closure order for removal work covers 16-18 Aug 2024; a PTI report published 20 Aug 2024 places a blockage on Monday 19 Aug; a regional report mentions a fresh mudslide on 22 Aug.
events.location_text: NH-29 near Dzudza bridge, Sechu Zubza; chainage km 163+980 to 164+030 per the Kohima district advisory

events.description: Landslide on the night of 22 August cut the Kohima-Khonoma road, one of the alternate routes advised while NH-29 was blocked at Dzudza.

events.description: Large landslide on the NH-29 stretch near Pherima on the night of 3 September, with loss of life reported, after the highway had reopened to single-lane traffic following the Dzudza blockage.
events.date_note: The articles give 3 September without a year in the retrieved text; 2024 is inferred from later coverage (Sept 2025 'washed away last year') and a Nov 2024 report citing September 2024 landslides. Confirm.
events.location_text: NH-29 near Pherima village, Chumoukedima district

sources.title: Nagaland: Pherima landslide claims six lives, causes extensive damage

events.description: A portion of NH-29 on the Pagla Pahar stretch was washed away by flooding of the Chathe River on the same night as the Pherima landslide, cutting main road connectivity towards Kohima.
events.date_note: Same year inference as the Pherima event. Confirm.
events.location_text: NH-29 Pagla Pahar stretch (Chathe River side)

sources.title: Fresh landslides strike Nagaland's NH-29; sever key links to Kohima and beyond

events.description: Multiple landslides between Chathe Bridge and New Chumoukedima halted traffic on the Dimapur-Kohima highway on 14 September; the Pagla Pahar stretch reported as washed away again. Police advisories restricted movement and listed alternate routes.
events.location_text: NH-29 between Chathe Bridge and New Chumoukedima (Pagla Pahar)

events.description: A suspension (wire) bridge over the Chathe River linking Chumoukedima and Seithekema was reported swept away or damaged when the river swelled on 14 September. Sources differ on the extent. Not a highway bridge.
events.location_text: Chathe River, between Chumoukedima and Seithekema
